_comment: WORKAROUND — DO NOT 'CLEAN UP' THE URLs BELOW. (2026-08-31)
Both Supabase entries deliberately use the BARE https://mcp.supabase.com/mcp with no query string.
They previously read '...?project_ref=<ref>&read_only=true'. That form is BROKEN right now:
Claude Code issue #34880 malforms the OAuth 'resource' parameter whenever the MCP server URL
carries query params, which fails auth with 'Resource must be a valid MCP endpoint'. Stripping
the query string is the documented workaround and is the only reason these URLs look unscoped.
*** SECOND, UNINTENDED EFFECT — READ BEFORE TRUSTING THE SERVER NAMES. ***
The query string carried TWO things, and removing it removed both. 'read_only=true' is gone from
supabase-prod-readonly, and 'project_ref' is gone from both. The two entries are now IDENTICAL,
so 'supabase-prod-readonly' is read-only IN NAME ONLY: nothing here scopes it to prod or blocks
writes. Which database a call reaches is decided entirely by the project_id argument passed per
call, not by which server it was addressed to. Whether read-only is still enforced via the OAuth
grant has NOT been verified. Assume PROD IS WRITABLE through either server until proven otherwise.
Project refs, for whoever restores the scoped URLs:
supabase-dev            -> zxwtxjjmssykhqrghouf  (system_identifier 7642734024280108049)
supabase-prod-readonly  -> parpauldmbetptkmdwbd  (system_identifier 7606130613603586966)
TO RESTORE: first check whether #34880 is fixed in the current Claude Code. Only if it is, put
back '?project_ref=<ref>&read_only=true' on each URL and re-authenticate. Restoring them while
the bug is open re-breaks authentication for both servers.
Tracked as ROADMAP NOW P1; see docs/ARCHITECTURE.md 'Supabase MCP config is on a bug workaround'.
